modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: April 15 is observed as Universal Day of Culture.
April 15 is observed as Pohela Boishakh (Bengali New Year; India).
On April 15, 2019: A fire severely damaged Notre-Dame de Paris, destroying the cathedral's timber spire and much of the roof.
On April 15, 1989: The death of former Chinese General Secretary Hu Yaobang triggered a series of events that led to the Tiananmen Square protests in Beijing.
On April 15, 1947: Jackie Robinson debuts for the Brooklyn Dodgers, breaking baseball's color line.
